trophies.name: Menace to Society
trophies.detail: Earn your first punishment for violating the People's Charter.

trophies.name: The Walls Have Eyes
trophies.detail: Violate the People's Charter ten times.

trophies.name: Munitions Magician
trophies.detail: Complete your first munitions facility production cycle.

trophies.detail: Complete your first medical facility production cycle.

trophies.detail: Complete your first weapons facility production cycle.

trophies.name: DIY Demon
trophies.detail: Upgrade a weapon to Level 10.

trophies.name: Fashion Accessory
trophies.detail: Give your Accessory a makeover, then visit the lobby area.

trophies.name: Natural Thorn Killer
trophies.detail: Claim all Thorn-related entitlements.

trophies.name: Antisocial Networking
trophies.detail: Exchange rap sheets with a fellow sinner.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.detail: Make your first item purchase using Entitlement Points.

trophies.name: Just Desserts
trophies.detail: Try every variety of ice cream.

trophies.name: No Man Left Behind
trophies.detail: Come to the aid of a fallen comrade ten times.

trophies.name: Severance Package
trophies.detail: Sever an Abductor component.

trophies.name: The Great Divide
trophies.detail: Sever five or more Abductor components in a single operation.

trophies.name: Scrap Merchant
trophies.detail: Harvest 50 different types of resources from destroyed Abductors.

trophies.name: Volunteer of the Year
trophies.detail: Successfully complete every discretionary operation.

trophies.name: Ramosa Disposer
trophies.detail: Defeat a Ramosa-class Abductor while playing offline without falling once in battle.

trophies.name: Paradoxa Boxer
trophies.detail: Defeat a Paradoxa-class Abductor while playing offline without falling once in battle.

trophies.name: Dionaea Slayer
trophies.detail: Defeat a Dionaea-class Abductor while playing offline without falling once in battle.

trophies.name: Pelta Pelter
trophies.detail: Defeat a Peltatum- or Oltatum-class Abductor while playing offline without falling once in battle.

trophies.name: Citizen's Friend
trophies.detail: Transport a citizen to a Resource Reclamation Unit during operation CT1-3 Dawn - Citizen Reclamation or later.

trophies.name: Constant Comrade
trophies.detail: Complete 15 operations while collaborating with other players.

trophies.name: I Want You Back
trophies.detail: Have your Accessory seized by an enemy Abductor.

trophies.name: The Only One for Me
trophies.detail: Successfully complete an Accessory Reclamation operation.

trophies.name: For the Greater Good!
trophies.detail: Successfully complete 15 special operations.

trophies.name: Trigger-Happy
trophies.detail: Fire over 9,999 rounds of ammunition.

trophies.name: Butterfingers
trophies.detail: Accidentally drop a citizen while carrying them to an RRU.

trophies.name: Marathorn Man
trophies.detail: Use your Thorn to cover a distance of 26 miles (42 km).
